reading.text: The Riverside Centre opens registration for its spring pottery classes on Monday. Each class meets once a week for six weeks, and the fee includes clay and access to shared tools. New participants should fill in the online form and choose a preferred class time. A confirmation email will arrive within two working days if a place is available. When a class is full, the centre puts applicants on a waiting list in the order their forms were received. Staff contact people on that list if a place opens before the first session. Participants who need step-free access can contact the front desk before registering so staff can confirm which room is suitable.
